units.source_text: 尚未说完，内大臣进邸内来了。

en.t: Before they had finished speaking, the Minister of the Interior came into the residence.

units.source_text: 云居雁无可奈何，连忙逃回自己房中去。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari had no choice and hurriedly fled back to her own room.

units.source_text: 夕雾留在这里，觉得很不像样，狼狈起来，也退入自己房中躺下了。

en.t: Yugiri felt it would be improper to remain there, grew flustered, and also withdrew to his own room and lay down.

units.source_text: 他听见内大臣唤云居雁快快上车，三辆车子悄悄地赶出去，心中不胜怅惘。

en.t: He heard the Minister of the Interior calling for Kumoi no Kari to get quickly into the carriage, and as three carriages quietly drove away, his heart was filled with unbearable melancholy.

units.source_text: 太君派人来叫他去，但他装作睡着，身体一动也不动。

en.t: The grandmother sent someone to summon him, but he pretended to be asleep and did not move a muscle.

units.source_text: 他的眼泪流个不住，啜泣直到天明，便在浓霜的清晨急急忙忙回东院去了。

en.t: His tears would not stop, and after sobbing until dawn, he hurried back to the eastern wing in the frost-heavy morning.

units.source_text: 因为他的两眼已经哭肿，被人看见了很难为情；

en.t: Because both his eyes were already swollen from crying, he would have been deeply embarrassed for anyone to see him;

units.source_text: 又怕太君要派人来叫他，还不如独自笼闭在书房里来得安心，所以急忙回去。

en.t: and fearing that the grandmother might send someone to call him again, he thought he would feel more at ease shut up alone in his study, so he hurried back.

units.source_text: 归途中独自思量，这并非别人害我，全是自寻苦恼。

en.t: On the way back, he reflected to himself that no one else had harmed him; all this suffering was of his own making.

units.source_text: 天色阴沉，四周还很黑暗。

en.t: The sky was overcast, and everything around him was still dark.
